title: Daggerheart Loot homebrew file, version 2
description: A GM's own items, their sources with sections, and their set and rule cards as one JSON file: the site imports it on the «Мои предметы» page and writes it on export. Version 2 is version 1 (homebrew-v1.json) with one addition: a card may hold book items (items), catalog record ids it also applies to; the site writes version 2 only when a card holds them, else version 1. llms.txt, section "Version 2: book items in a card (homebrew-v2)", describes it for AI assistants. The field names are the catalog's (data.json). At least one of books, cards and items holds an object. Frozen: a bound may widen in place, never narrow; any other change is homebrew-v3.json beside this one.

$schema.title: Schema
$schema.description: The URL of this schema, for editors. Ignored on import.

format.title: Format
format.description: Names the file as a homebrew file.

version.title: Version
version.description: The format version this schema describes.

exported_at.title: Exported at
exported_at.description: When the site wrote the file. Ignored on import.

books.title: Sources
books.description: The sources the items and cards belong to, each with its sections. The bound is one import's.

cards.title: Cards
cards.description: Set cards and rule cards that items name in set and refs. The bound is one import's.

items.title: Items
items.description: The items. The bound is one import's.

key.title: Key
key.description: A homebrew key: hb_ and 16 characters of a-z and 2-7. It names the object in one account and never changes; a key unique within its array. The site makes keys; a converter makes them at random.

relationId.title: Record id
relationId.description: A key of this file or the account, or an id from catalog.csv. An id that names nothing is kept and draws nothing.

section.title: Section
section.description: A section of a source. One of en and ru holds a character other than a space.

key.title: Key
key.description: The section's key, unique within its source; an item's section names it.

en.title: English name
en.description: The section's English name, in Unicode code points.

ru.title: Russian name
ru.description: The section's Russian name, in Unicode code points.

book.title: Source
book.description: A source: a book, a supplement or a setting the items come from. One of en and ru holds a character other than a space.

key.title: Key
key.description: The source's key; an item's or a card's book names it.

en.title: English name
en.description: The source's English name, in Unicode code points.

ru.title: Russian name
ru.description: The source's Russian name, in Unicode code points.

sections.title: Sections
sections.description: The source's sections in order, keys unique within the source.

card.title: Card
card.description: A set card (kind set: the bonus of the items that share it) or a rule card (kind ref: a rule an item refers to). One of en and ru holds a character other than a space; a set card holds no subtitle and no link.

key.title: Key
key.description: The card's key; an item's set or refs names it.

kind.title: Kind
kind.description: set for a set card, ref for a rule card. A card already in the account under the key with the other kind is skipped.

book.title: Source
book.description: The key of a source of this file; leave the key out for no source.

en.title: English name
en.description: The card's English name, in Unicode code points.

ru.title: Russian name
ru.description: The card's Russian name, in Unicode code points.

ensub.title: English subtitle
ensub.description: A rule card's English subtitle, such as its type.

ende.title: English text
ende.description: A set card's bonus or a rule card's text, in English.

rud.title: Russian text
rud.description: A set card's bonus or a rule card's text, in Russian.

url.title: Link
url.description: A rule card's link to its source: empty, or https:// and printable ASCII.

items.title: Book items
items.description: Catalog record ids from data.json that this card also holds: a set card's members, or the records a rule card applies to. An own item names the card in its own set or refs.

stats.title: Second stat set
stats.description: A weapon's second set of stats, used in its other mode.

trait.title: Trait
trait.description: The trait the weapon attacks with.

damage.title: Damage
damage.description: The damage die and a bonus of 1 to 99, as d8 or d10+2.

damageType.title: Damage type
damageType.description: phy physical, mag magic, any either.

eq.title: Stat block
eq.description: An equipment item's stats. A weapon (t weapon or secondary) holds cls, tr, rg, dmg, dt and bu; armour holds as and th. Write the tier from the source book; never work it out from the stats.

tier.title: Tier
tier.description: The tier from the source book, or A for an artifact.

cls.title: Class
cls.description: phy physical or mag magic weapon.

bu.title: Burden
bu.description: The hands the weapon takes: 1, 2, or any.

th.title: Thresholds
th.description: The armour's major and severe damage thresholds, the first lower than the second.

alt.title: Second stat set
alt.description: A weapon's second set of stats.

line.title: Upgrade line
line.description: The line the item upgrades along: a catalog record's line id (catalog.csv) or the key of the line's own first item. Every member of a line is of one equipment type.

item.title: Item
item.description: One item in the catalog's shape. One of en and ru holds a character other than a space.

key.title: Key
key.description: The item's key; it names the item in the account's lists.

book.title: Source
book.description: The key of a source of this file; leave the key out for no source.

section.title: Section
section.description: The key of a section of the item's own source; never without book.

kind.title: Kind
kind.description: item (kept), consumable (spent) or equip (a weapon or armour with eq).

en.title: English name
en.description: The item's English name, in Unicode code points.

ru.title: Russian name
ru.description: The item's Russian name, in Unicode code points.

tier.title: Tier
tier.description: A loot item's tier from its source book: 1-4, A artifact or C cursed; leave the key out for none. Equipment writes its tier in eq.

craft.title: Upgrades into
craft.description: The ids this item upgrades into; never the item's own key.

craft_from.title: Made from
craft_from.description: The ids this item is made from; never the item's own key.

set.title: Set card
set.description: The key of a set card of this file or the account, or a catalog set's key from data.json.

refs.title: Rule cards
refs.description: Keys of rule cards of this file or the account, or catalog rule card keys from data.json.
